prompt: Light-background realistic rendered product-style side view of fixed twin tri-star braked courier trolley mid-climb on stairs. Vertical single spine in centre, folding handle extended up at top, folding toe extended forward low carrying a parcel box, twin fixed tri-star clusters at base with six small wheels contacting two stair nosings simultaneously. One-way clutch and deadman disc mounted exposed on side of star axle and clearly visible, not hidden. Show FIXED spine to star axle versus FOLDING handle hinge and FOLDING toe hinge. Draw subtle force arrows from toe up spine to stars to stairs and braking at clutch to disc. Draw only these 5 short callouts with leader lines, no numbers in image: spine, twin fixed tri-stars, wheels, one-way clutch, deadman disc. Keep relative sizes and connections of reference.
must_not: numbers, dimensions, values or extra words in drawn labels
single wheel or rotating star without stair contact

visual_plan.spatial_layout: side view: vertical spine centre, folding handle up top, folding toe forward low with parcel, twin tri-star clusters low rear on stair nosings, wheels around stars, clutch and disc exposed at star axle side, stairs rising left to right behind
visual_plan.operating_moment: deployed trolley climbing stairs with two-nosing contact, loaded parcel on toe, holding load then deadman-metered braked descent
visual_plan.transfer_path: Force: folding toe -> spine -> twin tri-stars -> stair nosings | Measured: one-way clutch -> deadman disc
visual_plan.interactions: parcel sits on folding toe hinged to spine, spine fixed with keyed axle to twin tri-stars, tri-stars carry three wheels each on star-wheel axles, one-way clutch locks star axle for hold, deadman disc meters star rotation for descent, folding handle hinged to top of spine for pull
avoid: numbers or values in drawn text
hidden clutch or disc inside housing
